title: Read regression history
responsibility: Show the selected commit’s failing test and its exact passing fix.

inputs.name: regressionHash.bytes
inputs.description: Exact string or byte sequence to hash with SHA-256.

inputs.name: regressionHistory.commit
inputs.description: Selected source commit whose retained focused regression runs are projected.

inputs.name: regressionHistory.notes
inputs.description: Pinned Git notes identifying retained regression records.

inputs.name: regressionHistory.load
inputs.description: Reader that verifies and loads the record, log and files named by a regression note.

inputs.name: regressionHistory.media
inputs.description: Places verified capture bytes in the prepared history media store.

inputs.name: sameRegression.red
inputs.description: Failing checkpoint supplying the original tests, command, assertion and environment.

inputs.name: sameRegression.green
inputs.description: Candidate passing checkpoint to compare with the original regression inputs.

inputs.name: readRegression.note
inputs.description: Pinned regression note naming its committed evidence path and manifest hash.

inputs.name: readRegression.read
inputs.description: Reader for exact evidence bytes addressed relative to that retained record.

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: Linked failure and pass results, with explicit gaps for missing or corrupt proof

errors.name: Invalid proof
errors.description: Missing or damaged proof stays visible as a gap; it cannot become a passing result.
